messages:
maya: Quick sync 1 1 we need a compact UX for automatic fallback decisions. operators should see mode, trigger, and quota impact in one glance + drill into sampled requests. tagging @liam @sarah
liam: proposal: one-line status chip on rollout list + detail. chip = mode icon + reason shortcode + tiny quota delta badge. click opens audit drawer.
sarah: +1. add 'sample-only' toggle so we can run dry experiments. sampling view shows a handful of requests and an estimated token/month delta.
dan: API needs: stable enums for mode/reason, a compact header `X-Redwood-Fallback: mode=soft;reason=latency;id=0x2f9c` for downstream joins, and `?dry_run=true` on rollout endpoints. emit `decision_id` in telemetry.
aj: keep header tiny (128 bytes max), semicolon-separated k=v pairs, lowercase enums. we'll publish exact grammar.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy `autofallback-ui` started by @liam 1 logs: https://ci.redwood/example-run/4788
maya: UX deliverables: chip + hover tooltip (top signal), small 'Audit' CTA opening sampled requests, cooldown indicator if oscillating, and approver UI for protected rollouts.
liam: cooldown pill shows "cooldown: 2m" and a pause action. status API exposes cooldown remaining.
sarah: 'Why did we fallback?' modal should surface top 3 signals (p99 latency, error rate, quota saturation) and sample payloads.
dan: I'll add `dry_run` support and ensure sampled events include `decision_id` and `sampled=true`.
aj: telemetry change: add `fallback_reason` enum and `decision_id` to v1 events; keep flat event schema for ingestion. example event in docs: { decision_id: "0x2f9c", route: "checkout", fallback: { mode: "soft", reason: "latency" }, sampled: true }
maya: UI copy example: `[Soft 5b00 latency] 1 1 Quota est: -3.8% (monthly). Audit` 1 hover shows short signal reasons.
sarah: include link to Optimize remediation (batching/quant) from the chip.
liam: permission model: protected rollouts require rollout-owner + ops signoff. show approvers and block commit until approvals exist.
ops-bot: incident-bot: alert: sampling spike on route `auth-login` 2025-02-12T09:10Z 1 currently in sample-only mode.
dan: noted. will correlate `decision_id=0x2f9c` with logs and sampled payloads.
aj: action items: liam PR for UI chip + pause CTA, dan PR for `dry_run` + `decision_id`, aj docs update, sarah mock for audit drawer, maya copy + product signoff. sync tomorrow 09:30 to review canary metrics.
maya: if you want canary access DM me and I'll add you to the sample group.
